title: HSK 1.12 · 考试, 请假, 洗手间, 爱好, 教学楼
focus: 十 · 爸爸 · 热 · 试 · 差 · 教 · 冷 · 山 · 哥 · 爸 · 风 · 累 · 肉 · 休息 · 坏 · 洗 · 哥哥 · 考试 · 考 · 听见 · 请问 · 好听 · 爱好 · 放假 · 中文 · 放学 · 洗手间 · 请假 · 小学生 · 中学生 · 请进 · 好玩儿 · 小孩儿 · 教学楼 · 课文 · 请坐 · 听写 · 面条儿 · 男孩儿
body:
School life, weather and polite phrases. 请 opens four set phrases, 学 shows up in school words, and 放 (release) gives both school holidays and the end of the school day.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 请 | qǐng | please; request (讠 + 青) | 请问, 请假, 请进, 请坐 |
| 学 | xué | study; school | 放学, 小学生, 中学生, 教学楼 |
| 听 | tīng | listen | 听见, 好听, 听写 |
| 好 | hǎo / hào | good / be fond of | 好听, 爱好, 好玩儿 |
| 试 / 考 | shì / kǎo | try / test | 考试 |
| 放 | fàng | release (攵 + 方) | 放假, 放学 |
| 假 | jià | holiday, leave | 放假, 请假 |
| 孩 | hái | child | 小孩儿, 男孩儿 |

## Watch out

- 好 is hǎo (good) in 好听 but hào (to like) in 爱好.
- 假 is jià (time off) in 放假 and 请假; jiǎ means fake.
- 教 is jiāo when it's the verb "teach" but jiào in 教学楼 and 教室.
- 冷 has 冫 (two dots, ice); 洗 has 氵 (three dots, water).
- 考 vs 老: same top, but 考 ends in 丂 and 老 ends in 匕.
- 差 is chà (short of, poor) here; it's chā in 差别 and chāi in 出差.

cards.Example: 我十点睡觉。 wǒ shí diǎn shuìjiào: I go to bed at ten.
cards.Notes: A simple cross. Lookalikes: 千 qiān (thousand) adds ノ on top; 土 tǔ has two horizontals

cards.Example: 我爸爸也在。 wǒ bàba yě zài: My dad's here too.
cards.Notes: 爸 = 父 father + 巴 bā for the sound

cards.Example: 今天太热了。 jīntiān tài rè le: It's too hot today.
cards.Notes: 灬 fire (four dots) under 执 (simplified from 熱). 灬 at the bottom often means heat or cooking

cards.Example: 你试试这个。 nǐ shìshi zhège: Try this one.
cards.Notes: 讠 speech + 式 shì for the sound

cards.Example: 现在差五分八点。 xiànzài chà wǔ fēn bā diǎn: It's five to eight.
cards.Notes: A bent 羊 on top + 工. chà = lacking; also chā (difference) and chāi (errand, 出差) in later words

cards.Example: 妈妈教我做饭。 māma jiāo wǒ zuò fàn: Mom teaches me to cook.
cards.Notes: Left side looks like 孝 (老 over 子) + 攵 hand holding a stick. jiāo = teach; jiào in 教室, 教学楼

cards.Example: 外边很冷。 wàibian hěn lěng: It's cold outside.
cards.Notes: 冫 ice + 令 lìng for the sound. 冫 (2 dots, ice) vs 氵 (3 dots, water)

cards.Example: 我们去爬山吧。 wǒmen qù pá shān ba: Let's go hiking.
cards.Notes: Picture of three peaks. Lookalike: 出 chū looks like two 山 stacked

cards.Example: 我哥很高。 wǒ gē hěn gāo: My older brother is tall.
cards.Notes: Two 可 kě stacked; 可 hints at the sound

cards.Example: 爸，你回来了！ bà, nǐ huílai le: Dad, you're back!
cards.Notes: 父 father on top + 巴 bā for the sound

cards.Example: 今天风很大。 jīntiān fēng hěn dà: It's very windy today.
cards.Notes: 几-shaped frame + 㐅 inside (simplified from 風). Lookalike: 凤 fèng (phoenix) has 又 inside

cards.Example: 我今天很累。 wǒ jīntiān hěn lèi: I'm tired today.
cards.Notes: 田 over 糸 thread. lèi = tired; also lěi (accumulate) in rarer words

cards.Example: 我不吃肉。 wǒ bù chī ròu: I don't eat meat.
cards.Notes: Picture of a slab of meat with its grain. As a radical it shrinks to 月 (肚, 脸)

cards.Example: 你休息一下。 nǐ xiūxi yíxià: Take a rest.
cards.Notes: 休 = 亻 person leaning against 木 tree; 息 has 心 heart underneath

cards.Example: 电视坏了。 diànshì huài le: The TV is broken.
cards.Notes: 土 earth + 不 (simplified from 壞, crumbling earth). Opposite: 好

cards.Example: 我去洗手。 wǒ qù xǐ shǒu: I'll go wash my hands.
cards.Notes: 氵 water + 先 xiān for the sound

cards.Example: 我有一个哥哥。 wǒ yǒu yí ge gēge: I have an older brother.
cards.Notes: 哥 is 可 kě stacked twice

cards.Example: 明天有考试。 míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì: There's an exam tomorrow.
cards.Notes: 考 test + 试 try = test and try: exam

cards.Meaning: to take an exam; to test
cards.Example: 你考得怎么样？ nǐ kǎo de zěnmeyàng: How did your exam go?
cards.Notes: Shares the top 耂 with 老 lǎo (old). 考 ends with 丂; 老 ends with 匕

cards.Example: 你听见了吗？ nǐ tīngjiàn le ma: Did you hear that?
cards.Notes: 听 listen + 见 perceive (result) = listen and it registers: hear. Like 看见

cards.Example: 请问，洗手间在哪儿？ qǐngwèn, xǐshǒujiān zài nǎr: Excuse me, where's the restroom?
cards.Notes: 请 please (讠 + 青 qīng for the sound) + 问 ask (门 door + 口 mouth)

cards.Example: 这首歌真好听。 zhè shǒu gē zhēn hǎotīng: This song is lovely.
cards.Notes: 好 good + 听 listen = good to hear. Like 好看, 好吃

cards.Example: 你有什么爱好？ nǐ yǒu shénme àihào: What are your hobbies?
cards.Notes: 爱 love + 好 hào like = what you love and like. 好 is hào here, not hǎo

cards.Example: 我们下周放假。 wǒmen xià zhōu fàngjià: We're off next week.
cards.Notes: 放 release (攵 + 方 fāng for the sound) + 假 jià holiday = released for a holiday

cards.Example: 你会看中文吗？ nǐ huì kàn Zhōngwén ma: Can you read Chinese?
cards.Notes: 中 China (Middle Kingdom) + 文 writing, language

cards.Example: 几点放学？ jǐ diǎn fàngxué: What time does school let out?
cards.Notes: 放 release + 学 school = released from school

cards.Example: 洗手间在楼上。 xǐshǒujiān zài lóushàng: The restroom is upstairs.
cards.Notes: 洗 wash + 手 hand + 间 room = hand-washing room: polite word for toilet

cards.Example: 我明天请假。 wǒ míngtiān qǐngjià: I'm taking tomorrow off.
cards.Notes: 请 request + 假 jià leave = request leave. 假 is jià here, not jiǎ (fake)

cards.Example: 她是小学生。 tā shì xiǎoxuéshēng: She's in primary school.
cards.Notes: 小学 primary school (small school) + 生 student

cards.Example: 我哥是中学生。 wǒ gē shì zhōngxuéshēng: My brother is in high school.
cards.Notes: 中学 secondary school (middle school) + 生 student

cards.Example: 请进，请坐。 qǐng jìn, qǐng zuò: Come in, have a seat.
cards.Notes: 请 please + 进 enter (辶 movement + 井) = please enter

cards.Example: 这个游戏很好玩儿。 zhège yóuxì hěn hǎowánr: This game is fun.
cards.Notes: 好 good + 玩 play + 儿 -r = good to play with: fun

cards.Example: 小孩儿都喜欢糖。 xiǎoháir dōu xǐhuan táng: Kids all love candy.
cards.Notes: 小 small + 孩 child + 儿 -r

cards.Example: 教学楼在那边。 jiàoxuélóu zài nàbian: The classroom building is over there.
cards.Notes: 教学 teaching (教 is jiào here) + 楼 building

cards.Example: 请读一下课文。 qǐng dú yíxià kèwén: Please read the text.
cards.Notes: 课 lesson + 文 writing = lesson text

cards.Example: 请坐，喝杯茶。 qǐng zuò, hē bēi chá: Sit down, have some tea.
cards.Notes: 请 please + 坐 sit (two 人 on 土 ground)

cards.Example: 今天有听写。 jīntiān yǒu tīngxiě: We have dictation today.
cards.Notes: 听 listen + 写 write = write what you hear

cards.Example: 我想吃面条儿。 wǒ xiǎng chī miàntiáor: I want noodles.
cards.Notes: 面 flour + 条 strip (夂 + 木) + 儿 -r = flour strips

cards.Example: 那个男孩儿是我弟弟。 nàge nánháir shì wǒ dìdi: That boy is my little brother.
cards.Notes: 男 man (田 field + 力 strength) + 孩 child + 儿 -r
